# Historical SQLite compatibility fixture

`storage-be94f75.db` was generated by the public SQLite driver at TSD commit
`be94f75`, before the v2 facade migration. Its SHA-256 is
`0284f50ab0191ff3139cf758df94aefb010dbdc7184e27ed6544f03df91a3801`.

It contains a `local`-scope document (`fixture/document`), stream record
(`fixture.events`), and blob (`fixture/blob`), plus historical scope admission
and purge receipt rows. The surviving document and blob primitive tests open
this unchanged database and verify the records remain readable.
